start: Settings, Units, set to kg, km

user_sees: Page titled 'Units' with 'kg, km' and 'lb, miles'
'lb, miles' selected
must_not: Stored weights converted and saved again (they stay metric)

steps.action: Close the app fully and open it again
user_sees: Weights shown in lb
must_not: The choice back to kg, km after the restart

steps.action: Close the app (swipe it away) at step 1 of "App settings kept on the phone", then open it again.

note: The choice is written to storage after the tap; a kill right after must keep it
